name: Claude Code
description: Indexes Claude Code chat sessions from the local Claude Code projects directory so they are searchable in Gety.

fields.title: Claude Code projects directory
fields.description: Optional override. Defaults to ~/.claude/projects on Linux/macOS and %USERPROFILE%\.claude\projects on Windows.

fields.title: Include subagent sessions
fields.description: Index Claude Code subagent and workflow JSONL logs in addition to top-level sessions.
